transformation: Original bipyramid wirework commission; replaces pointer-stoppable rotation with nonrepeating autonomous 3D yaw, pitch and roll. Adds visible bounded motion trails/forecasts, geometrically replayed endpoints and immutable terminal failure. Retains vertex identity, polygon closure and source scoring formula. Source used player ownership; this task explicitly uses target wires rather than copying the two-player game.
